label: early copy phase (2nd/3rd output) of long sequences
explanation: Never active in the original phase; ~98% of mass is in the copy phase, concentrated at recall_idx 1 (68% of mass, the step right after <DEL> where the model outputs orig(1) with orig(0) as input) and recall_idx 2 (27%), rarely at the delimiter step. Rate rises steeply with sequence length (L=9 holds 47% of mass; L<=5 nearly silent), so it tracks early copy steps with many outputs still to go (to_go 5-7). The predicate captures ~84% of mass on dev but precision is only ~10%: only a token-dependent minority of these positions cross threshold. Upcoming/output tokens modulate it (out_tok z,e,0,b and next_out 0,b,f,e have 4-7x lift) but no clean token set was found (token-conditioned variants reached F1 ~0.3 at most). Does not fire on later copy steps, short sequences, or any original-phase input.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: out_tok=z (+2.12), recall_idx=1 (+2.02), prev_tok=<DEL> (+2.02), orig4=0 (+1.88), orig5=c (+1.87), orig3=0 (+1.86). Lower it: recall_idx=5 (-3.64), to_go=1 (-2.75), out_tok=- (-2.59), phase=0 (-2.59).
